messages:
IncidentBot: Pager: gen-queue latency spike detected in us-west-2. 5xxs rising, error pattern: kv-cache-timeout. Alert: https://alerts.redwood.in/alert/abc123 :rotating_light:
Alex K: I'm oncall and jumping on the bridge now — starting triage. Can someone draft the initial statuspage update? need 1-2 bullets and customer impact.
Mike R: on the bridge. seeing increased tail latency on gen-queue workers, memory pressure on pod group gq-usw-3. collecting logs.
Sara M: I can draft the status copy. quick question — is this affecting embeddings or generation endpoints? need to state impacted products precisely.
Mike R: primarily generation (text-gen) and streaming sessions in us-west-2. embeddings and dedicated pools look fine so far.
Jamal: possible recent rollout of batching config at 10:42 UTC — if we revert to batch-size=8 -> 4 we can stop the OOMs. rolling that back now (./deploy revert batching-config-usw).
Alex K: Jamal please post the rollback command output here and timeline. Sara, start with an initial "investigating" status. Use neutral wording: region, affected product, mitigation in progress.
Sara M: draft here for review:
```
We are investigating increased latency in the US-West region impacting generation (text-gen) and streaming sessions. Our on-call team is actively investigating and has begun rolling back a recent batching configuration change. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.
Customer impact: Intermittent higher latency and occasional failed requests for generation in us-west-2. No impact to embeddings or dedicated capacity at this time.
```
Linda P: add SLA note: "Customers on SLA tiers may see increased error rates; we are treating this as P1 for affected region." Also add contact link to support.
Sara M: updated draft and posted to staging status page: https://status.redwood.in/incidents/5419876543-draft — please review short copy and highlight if we should call out workaround (client retry/backoff).
Mike R: rollback completed at 5419876780, pod group stabilized, 5xxs dropping. attaching tail logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T15:19:40Z] gq-worker-3 OOM kill triggered
[2026-03-17T15:20:02Z] rollback batching-config applied
[2026-03-17T15:20:35Z] gq-worker-3 restart ok
```
Alex K: great. Sara, change status to "mitigating" and note rollback timestamp. I'll prepare the public update.
Sara M: updated copy to "Mitigating — rollback applied at 15:20 UTC, error rates decreasing. Monitoring." Posted as update 2 on staging.
IncidentBot: Automated check: current 5xx rate down 84% compared to peak.
Alex K: final verification in progress, running synthetic checks across routes. If green in 10m we post resolved.
Jamal: synthetic run results: gen latency returned to baseline at 15:25 UTC. No further OOMs in last 5m.
Linda P: ops/legal reviewed the comm wording, ok to publish. Recommend including note on cause (config change) and a follow-up postmortem.
Sara M: publishing initial + mitigating + resolved sequence to statuspage now. Published links:
- Initial investigating: https://status.redwood.in/incidents/5419876543/initial
- Mitigating (rollback applied): https://status.redwood.in/incidents/5419876543/update-2
- Resolved: https://status.redwood.in/incidents/5419876543/resolved
Alex K: resolved note: "Issue resolved — batching config rollback restored stability. We will follow up with a post-incident report including root cause and timeline." Great work everyone :thumbsup:
IncidentBot: Incident resolved marker applied. Closing pager.
